summary: folder-lint preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: On npm install, package.json's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks and chmods it, and then uses it to execute a sibling file math_init.js — a 728KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle with string-array rotation and hex-mangled identifiers (`// @bun @bun-cjs`, `WV8StW`/`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())` shape). The package advertises itself as a 'Folder lint library' with main=lib/index.js; the legitimate lib/ code neither imports nor references math_init.js, and neither math_init.js nor setup.mjs is listed in package.json `files`. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscated `_0xNNNN` identifiers. The pattern — alternate-runtime dropper executing an opaque payload at install time whose purpose is unrelated to the declared functionality — is a canonical install-time RCE vector: the Bun runtime is fetched from its official domain, but the code it is used to execute is a shipped obfuscated blob rather than the package's advertised functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
